task: Build mobile-first web UI wrapping the animation pipeline tools
resume_brief: Build 'pocket studio': a mobile-first web app (single-page, big touch targets, works in a phone browser) wrapping the pipeline tools in ~/workspace/video-fix-tools/: background removal (rembg/run_rembg.py), sticker maker (sticker-kit/run_sticker.py), tracing (tracing/trace_kit.py or run_trace.py), upscale (upscale/run_upscale.py), loop-kit (run_loop.py), cartoonize (whitebox + animeganv3). Flow: upload image from phone -> pick tool (+ a couple of options) -> process -> preview + download result. Implement with Python stdlib http.server + subprocess (no new dependencies), mobile-first CSS. Serve persistently (systemd user service or nohup with restart), expose via cloudflared quick tunnel (free, no account: download cloudflared binary), verify the public URL loads and a full upload->process->download round trip works. Report the public URL. Do not touch trippedd-studio worktrees.
